```plato

    // Simpson's weight for sample i of n panels: 1 at the ends, 4 at odd
    // interior samples, 2 at even ones.
    SimpsonWeight(i: Integer, panels: Integer): Number
        => i == 0 || i == panels ? 1.0 : (i % 2 == 1 ? 4.0 : 2.0);
```
